name: JJG House Show, 14 October 2001

matches.note: Eric Echo wins a one-sided opener, absorbing an early foreign-object shot before finishing with an inverted implant DDT.
E.J. Drivven wins with a gutwrench sitdown powerbomb, a run of suplexes, and a hooked backdrop driver.
Corrupted Morals win by repeated cheating and double-teaming, including a chair shot the referee never sees.
Bret Lane wins against a much larger opponent with a low blow and a rollup.
Sid Savage wins with a bridging brainbuster.
Cameron Hawkins wins the main event with a top-rope skytwister press after absorbing a long beating.
